state:
- The initiating event is only a stress-activated kinase and some FG-flanking serine or threonine on NUP98, so the proposed alanine and acidic alleles are not a defined edit. Map stress-induced NUP98 sites first, mutate only those residues, and test one named candidate kinase in the same neurons.
- S1 reports that disease-linked TDP-43 disrupts nucleoporin localization and transport, while the write-up uses that result mainly as later aggregate reinforcement. Add a disease-linked TDP-43 perturbation in the phosphorylation-resistant NUP98 line and state that continued import failure supports a TDP-43-upstream route, whereas protection supports a required NUP98 phosphorylation step.
- The stress regimen, stress-granule block, and cytoplasmic TDP-43-assembly suppression are unnamed, and FG-barrier cohesion is inferred only from an NLS reporter. Name each regimen and reagent, add a size-selective permeability or FG-interaction assay, and count selective NLS-import failure with preserved NES export and a stable Ran gradient as the observation that favors the NUP98 hypothesis.
